## Cooling

### 2.5-slot Design

The Prime GeForce RTX 5080 features a 2.5 slot design with a carefully arranged layout for the shroud, heatsink and heat pipes to let the three Axial-tech fans leverage chassis side-panel ventilation and deliver optimal thermal performance.

### Axial-tech Upgrades

Three tried-and-true Axial-tech fans feature a smaller hub that facilitates longer blades and a barrier ring to increase downward air pressure for lower temperatures, less noise and higher performance. 

### 0dB Technology

All three fans come to a standstill when GPU temperatures are below 50 Celsius, letting you play less demanding games or perform light tasks in relative silence. Fans start up again when temperatures are over 55 C, establishing a speed curve that balances performance and acoustics for work or play.

ASUS GeForce RTX 5080 16GB PRIME is a custom-designed graphics card with the GB203-400 chip. Made for users focused on high-performance 1440p and 4K gaming, with attention to power use and noise. Using a non-reference design, it adds a stronger cooler and power delivery to sustain higher clock speeds. This custom version may cost at or above the reference MSRP of $999 USD due to upgraded components.

At its core, graphics work is handled by the GB203 chip built on the 4nm manufacturing process. The 4nm node allows about 45.6 billion transistors on a 378 mm² die. For rendering, the chip has 10,752 CUDA Cores, 336 texture units, and 112 raster operators. For modern games, the GPU provides 84 Ray Tracing Cores and 336 Tensor Cores for AI features.

ASUS GeForce RTX 5080 16GB comes with 16 GB of GDDR7 memory. Memory connects over a 256-bit interface with 960 GB/s bandwidth. The bandwidth reduces slowdowns under heavy load. The GPU runs at up to 2640 MHz.

...

For displays, it offers 3x DisplayPort 2.1b and 1x HDMI 2.1. It uses a a PCI-Express interface slot and draws power via 1× 16-pin. A 850 W PSU is recommended.
